crossRefs.note: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.
Furthermore Yahweh was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should…
but I must die in this land. I must not go over the Jordan, but you shall go over and possess that good land.
Therefore Yahweh brought on them the captains of the army of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh in chains, bound…
Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah, and teach out of your law,
Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.
It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.
Why does a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Yahweh.
But when he came to himself he said, ‘How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough to spare, and I’m dying…
But when we are judged, we are punished by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.
Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions…
For our transgressions are multiplied before you, and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us…
Because he considers, and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed, he shall surely live. He shall…
The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly;
The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I…

translations.web: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.
translations.bsb: then He tells them their deeds and how arrogantly they have transgressed.
translations.kjv: Then he sheweth them their work, and their transgressions that they have exceeded.
translations.asv: Then he showeth them their work, And their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.
